scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix admin && npm install --prefix api
scripts.ci:all: npm ci && npm ci --prefix client && npm ci --prefix admin && npm ci --prefix api
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "API,CLIENT,ADMIN" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix api" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix admin"
